query_original: How many points does the winner of a full-distance Grand Prix receive under the 2026 General Regulations?
resposta: According to Article 2.1.3 of the 2026 FIA Formula One World Championship Technical and Sporting Regulations, the winner of a full-distance Grand Prix receives 25 points.
